### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>seccomp/libseccomp-golang (github.com/seccomp/libseccomp-golang)</summary>

### [`v0.12.0`](https://redirect.github.com/seccomp/libseccomp-golang/releases/tag/v0.12.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/seccomp/libseccomp-golang/compare/v0.11.1...v0.12.0)

This version fixes a multitude of issues when the versions of libseccomp used during the compile and the runt time differ. See [#​129](https://redirect.github.com/seccomp/libseccomp-golang/issues/129) for more details.

#### What's Changed

- Workarounds for different libseccomp version during runtime (vs compile time) by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​129](https://redirect.github.com/seccomp/libseccomp-golang/pull/129)
- ci: bumps and nits, add arm64 by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​125](https://redirect.github.com/seccomp/libseccomp-golang/pull/125)
- CI bumps, Makefile improvements by [@​kolyshkin](https://redirect.github.com/kolyshkin) in [#​130](https://redirect.github.com/seccomp/libseccomp-golang/pull/130)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/seccomp/libseccomp-golang/compare/v0.11.1...v0.12.0>

</details>
